ingredients.name: Gelatin

scholarly_notes.general_sunni: Most scholars treat pork gelatin as haram. Bovine gelatin requires halal slaughter. Fish gelatin is generally accepted.

daily_tips: When a label says “natural flavors,” ask the manufacturer about animal or alcohol sources.
Gelatin in vitamins is often pork-based — look for “halal gelatin” or cellulose capsules.
E120 (carmine) is insect-based red color. Beet or paprika colors are common alternatives.
Microbial rennet cheeses are usually easier to verify than animal rennet cheeses.
This app shares information, not a fatwa. For tough cases, ask a trusted local scholar.
Lipstick and blush may contain carmine. Check color additives on the ingredient list.
Alcohol-free vanilla is widely available for baking.
Agar and pectin are plant gels that replace gelatin in many desserts.
